Title: Azure Notification Hubs .NET SDK now compatible with .NET Standard 2.0

Body.Content: Azure Notification Hubs .NET SDK now runs on any .NET platform, including .NET core for back-end environments. We’ve also made a significant effort to keep most of the APIs the same, so you can easily upgrade your code. Learn more in the documentation.
